skills.name: 3D Modeling Fundamentals
skills.summary: Clean topology, real-world scale, reference-led modeling, edge flow, normals, and production-ready mesh creation.

skills.name: Blender Workflows
skills.summary: Non-destructive Blender workflows, modifiers, scene organization, hotkeys, file hygiene, and production pipeline practices.

skills.name: Camera Animation
skills.summary: Story-driven camera composition, movement, pacing, and continuity.

skills.name: Character Rigging
skills.summary: Robust character control rigs, deformation quality, and animator-friendly controls.

skills.name: Facial Animation
skills.summary: Expressive facial performance including eyes, brows, mouth, jaw, and head integration.

skills.name: Keyframe Animation
skills.summary: Key poses, timing, spacing, breakdowns, arcs, and polished animation curves.

skills.name: Lighting Rendering
skills.summary: Lighting, look development, rendering quality, and performance.

skills.name: LOD Optimization
skills.summary: Level-of-detail strategy balancing visual fidelity and runtime performance.

skills.name: Material Creation
skills.summary: PBR materials, shader organization, physically plausible surface response, and texture quality.

skills.name: Maya Workflows
skills.summary: Maya project organization, technical workflows, and production asset delivery.

skills.name: Motion Capture
skills.summary: Capture preparation, data cleanup, retargeting, and end-to-end character animation integration.

skills.name: Particle Systems
skills.summary: Procedural particle effects for natural and stylized visual effects.

skills.name: Physics Simulation
skills.summary: Believable collisions, cloth and fluid interaction, scale-aware simulation, and caching.

skills.name: Procedural Modeling
skills.summary: Rule-driven geometry generation and repeatable procedural asset variation.

skills.name: Retopology
skills.summary: Animation-friendly topology reconstruction, deformation flow, UV readiness, and efficient meshes.

skills.name: Scene Composition
skills.summary: Visual storytelling through spatial arrangement, depth, lighting, and camera framing.

skills.name: Sculpting Digital
skills.summary: Organic forms, creature and character sculpting, anatomical structure, and high-detail meshes.

skills.name: Blender Tentacle Spline IK Rigging
skills.summary: Curve-driven spline IK for tails, tentacles, and flexible appendages with repeatable pose checks.

skills.name: Texture Painting
skills.summary: Direct texture authoring, surface detail, wear, and coherent visual material storytelling.

skills.name: UV Mapping
skills.summary: UV layout, seam planning, distortion control, texel density, and efficient packing.

skills.name: Walk Cycles
skills.summary: Grounded locomotion, weight transfer, timing, overlapping action, and quadruped/biped gait.

anthroforge_relevance: Modeling and retopology: improve species body meshes, topology flow, deformation loops, and mesh QA.
Character rigging and spline IK: improve species-specific rigs, tails, ears, appendages, skinning, and corrective deformation.
Motion capture, keyframes, and walk cycles: establish reusable animation validation and locomotion test suites.
Facial animation: support expressive face rigs and facial deformation QA.
Materials, UVs, and LODs: improve export-ready asset packaging and runtime budgets.
Physics: evaluate collision, cloth, and secondary-motion workflows only where they integrate cleanly with the current character pipeline.
